rule: A break spot's cost split evenly across the cards it hit, rounded to the penny. This is the number written to each linked card's price_paid, which is what keeps Total Paid correct without break-sourced cards needing special handling. A spot with no hits has no per-hit cost at all.

cases.why: recurring decimal, rounded down at the penny
no hits means no allocation, not zero
one hit carries the whole cost
exact half penny: rounds away from zero, not to even
small amounts still land on the penny
